subject: English First Additional Language

source.subtopic: Week 5: initial /y/ (yes, yet, yum); sound differentiation; claps syllables in sight words

show.line: Listen. y, y, yes. y, y, yum! Yes starts with y.

rounds.prompt: Which one starts with y, as in yes?
Say the sound with me. y, as in yum!
Is it y or j? Listen. Yet.
Clap the word special. Spe, cial. How many claps?

hints: Smile and say y. y, y, yes.
y and j are different. Yes, jet.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find a word that starts with y.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Jam starts with j. Yum starts with y.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen together. y, y, yum. Yum starts with y!

parent_line: Can hear the y sound at the start of words like yes, yum and yet.
